facts.business: Radiant Cash Management Services Limited is India's leading integrated cash logistics and cash management service provider, offering comprehensive solutions including cash pick-up and delivery, network cash management, cash van operations, cash processing, value-added services, and specialised logistics for valuables to banks, financial institutions, retail chains, e-commerce companies, petroleum outlets, and other commercial establishments across the country.

key_risks: Geopolitical developments and higher energy prices impacting global growth
Crude oil price volatility and weather-related uncertainties affecting India's growth outlook
Revenue recognition risk due to high volume of transactions and unbilled revenue
Regulatory changes including new labour codes and GST compliance
Dependence on banking and financial institution clients
Operational risks in cash logistics including security and fleet management
facts.related_party_note: Corporate guarantees provided by Radiant Cash Management Services Limited to its subsidiaries (Aceware Fintech Services Private Limited and Acemoney Payment Solution Private Limited) for their borrowing facilities from various banks including Bajaj Finserv, RBL Bank, IDFC First Bank, Yes Bank, and Federal Bank.
